scenarios.name: search
scenarios.note: RESOLVED by the 2026-07-28 r2c verifier amendment (scripts/waves/verify-w0.ts commit dcf483dab), after Sol rejected the r2b probe as gameable by an always-empty-200 stub. The scenario now asserts a KNOWN MATCH against the frozen searchProbe (top-level field above) -- GET /api/projects/<searchProbe.projectId>/search?q=<searchProbe.needle> must return >=1 match whose file === searchProbe.expectFile on every timed repetition -- plus a negative control (a random nonce query must return 2xx with zero matches). Confirmed live, 3 independent runs: project bde3b40d-f47e-418f-b8d2-66701c4de690 is listed in GET /api/projects; the positive probe (q=doctype) returns 200 with exactly one match {file: "steady-landing.html", line: 2, snippet: "<!doctype html>"} on every repetition across all 3 runs; the negative control (random nonce query) returns 200 with zero matches every time. httpOkAll=true (combined positive-match + negative-control) in all 3 runs. See docs/testing/scale-baseline-2026-07.md 'Known issue: search scenario' for the full history.
